title: Scale and conformal symmetry in four-dimensional operational quantum field theory
main_claim: Take a 4D unitary, positive-energy QFT with a Poincaré- and dilation-invariant vacuum. Assume a discrete, bounded-below dimension spectrum with finite multiplicities, finite scaling support for the fields, a causally commuting bounded local net with affiliated field realizations, and a local virial current V with T^mu_mu = d^mu V_mu. Then there is a Hermitian dimension-2 physical scalar L with d.V^(3) = Box L, so T^(4) + (1/3)(dd - eta Box)L is symmetric, conserved and traceless with unchanged Poincaré charges, and the conformal currents have unbroken local Ward identities (scale implies local conformal invariance).
coverage: This was a partial audit of an 8.6k-line paper. Read in full: the introduction, the main theorem, and Section 2 (framework assumption, old-domain proposition, current-weight selection, BW/modular inputs, strip comparison lemma, timelike vacuum channels, scalar comparison copies, parabolic generators, bounded-cut commutation, Taylor comparison, scalar spectral comparison, normal form bound). Also read Section 4 lines 1-135 and 400-767 (plane matrix, exact Hankel tail, plateau estimates, order-zero comparison / critical-tail removal) and the end of Section 7 (Jt three-point structure, special flux, Return of the scalar wave theorem). Checked with sympy/scipy: (1) the free-scalar example (trace, Box(-Q/2), improvement coefficients); (2) the null-conformal generator formula H_nu(M^nu e^{ipx}) = (2u^2 a - 2u k.y + b|y|^2 - 2iu(nu+2)) M^nu e^{ipx}, exact; (3) the Hankel transfer identity H_2 H_0 F = (2/v^2) int_0^v rF - F, checked numerically; (4) c_* = 6 int t^3 K_0 = 24; (5) tail relations giving <d_jz, d_sz> = ||d_l||^2/3; (6) the l-J-t three-point structure (trace and divergence constraints give A = B, D = -6B; tensor divergence also vanishes); (7) the special-flux angular contraction -delta - 2nn with sphere average -3/2 delta. The light-cone exclusion and dimension-2 normalization of l = -Theta/M^2 were checked by hand. Every step I checked was correct. Not verified in detail: Section 3 (bounded-profile Ward formula, internal measure with kappa <= h), Section 5 (cone modularity, time-Möbius action), Section 6 (extraction of S), most of Section 7 (pair-space conformal representation), and Section 8 (mixed products, common domain, affiliation). Those sections carry the operator-theoretic reconstruction, so the no_gap verdict covers only the parts listed above.
